title: IM Integration
desc: Enter DingTalk / Feishu / WeCom custom-app credentials, save them securely on this machine, then authorize via OAuth and send a test message.
scopeNote: Secrets are stored only on this machine and encrypted by OS secure storage. Open each platform's official portal first to create an app, then fill in the fields below.
bridgeNotReady: Main-process bridge not ready — restart the app and retry.

platformDesc.dingtalk: DingTalk Open Platform → Enterprise Internal App → Robot: AppKey / AppSecret / AgentId.
platformDesc.feishu: Feishu Open Platform → Enterprise Custom App → Add bot + Event Subscription: App ID / App Secret / Verification Token.
platformDesc.wecom: WeCom Admin Console → App Management → Custom App → Receive Messages: CorpID / AgentID / Secret / Token.

secretPlaceholder: Leave a saved secret blank to keep it unchanged
cryptoUnavailable: Secure storage unavailable on this machine — refusing to save the secret in plaintext
pairNeedConfig: Save the config before generating a pairing code
pairingIntro: Use the pairing code / link below to connect a mobile IM client:
pairingExpire: The pairing code is valid for {min} minutes; regenerate if expired.
oauthStartOk: Authorization link opened. Finish it in the browser; this page will pick up the result automatically.
callbackPlaceholder: If the browser did not redirect back, paste the full URL here
callbackInvalid: Missing state / code in the URL. Paste the full callback URL.
